text.p: Intellicell Corp said Thursday that Richard A. Eisner & Co LLP had resigned as Intellicell's independent auditor.
Eisner, in a letter to Intellicell, said it was "unable to rely on the integrity of management," the company said.
Intellicell said the audit committee of its board is investigating the circumstances of the resignation.

"Management is fully confident that the company's internal books and records accurately reflect the company's financial condition and results of operations for all periods involved," Chief Operating Officer James Bunting said.

He said management was "surprised" and "disappointed" by Eisner's action. He said Intellicell had complied with all of the auditor's procedures and requests and was prepared to continue working with Eisner.
He added, "Business continues to be robust and industry dynamics remain strong."
Intellicell intends to retain another accounting firm to complete its 1996 year-end audit, Bunting said.
Eisner audited Intellicell's books in 1994 and 1995.
